text:
jamie_support: FYI customer 8432 on enterprise says users keep getting reauth popups after we migrated org claim last night. Happening on Chrome only; some users on iOS app unaffected.
robin_cse: ticket 8432 - they mention 'relogin every 15-20m' and 'device trust failed'
jamie_support: repro steps from customer: login SSO -> accept device trust -> works for ~10-20m -> suddenly 401 on api calls -> frontend shows 'please reauthenticate'. They pasted this header: Authorization: Bearer <token> and response: 401 invalid_token "session expired".
alex_eng: I saw a similar heap during org-claim rollout. Can you grab request ids and the cookie header when it fails?
jamie_support: pasted logs from browser console:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions 401 0.21s
x-request-id: req_01Fabcdef123
set-cookie: session=eyJ...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Max-Age=1800
www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="device_jwt_rejected: claim mismatch"
```
robin_cse: customer also sent SAML assertion digest — maybe we rotated the claim name. @alex_eng any config that could reject device_jwt after claim name normalization?
alex_eng: During the migration we added an alias mapping: 'org' and 'organization_id' both accepted, but device_jwt validator still only reads 'org'. If the assertion uses organization_id, validator rejects.
sre_bot: deploy 2026-03-15T02:43:12 rolled org-claim alias, then hotfix 2026-03-15T03:02:10 updated validator. Can cause brief inconsistencies across instances.
jamie_support: customer timeline aligns with 2026-03-15T03:00 UTC. So some servers still on old build.
robin_cse: workaround for customer: ask them to logout/relogin to refresh device_jwt and confirm all sessions get new cookie. Also can we issue one-time 'force-sync' for their org?
alex_eng: I'll check if we can backfill by accepting either claim for a 24h window or issue a migration script. For immediate: add a proxy rule to accept both claims on edge for their org id.
jamie_support: sent customer instructions: logout -> clear cookies -> SSO login -> confirm 'Device trusted' banner shows. Customer replied it's a temporary fix but happens again after ~12h.
alex_eng: that's likely because session cookie Max-Age is 1800s; but customer sees 12h so refresh token path might not be issuing new device_jwt on refresh. Need repro.
robin_cse: can support capture HAR from a user when it fails? request-id at failure would help (x-request-id).
jamie_support: I've asked for HAR and a user account to test. Also added their org to priority queue. @alex_eng can you check token refresh path in auth service for claim reading?
alex_eng: On it. I see auth-service:v2.4.1 reads 'org' only. Will patch today and coordinate an infra restart to minimize disruption. ETA 4h.
robin_cse: thanks. tagging @legal_ops for potential incident SLA breach.
jamie_support: noted. Logging ticket updates. :thumbsup:
